name: Post Matric Scholarship Scheme (Government of India) for ST students - Maharashtra
provider: Tribal Development Department, Government of Maharashtra (centrally sponsored, via MahaDBT)

rules.quote: Scheme of Post Matric Scholarships to the students belonging to Scheduled Tribes for Studies in India
If Family Income <= 2,50,000, he will get the scholarship
Back to back drop for 2 years he/she will not be allowed to fill form.

amount.text: Maintenance per month hosteller/day scholar: Group 1 Rs 1200/550, Group 2 Rs 820/530, Group 3 Rs 570/300, Group 4 Rs 380/230; plus book grant Rs 1200 pa, study tour Rs 1600 pa, disability allowances

documents.name: Caste validity (professional courses)
documents.quote: Professional Course selected than caste validity certificate mandatory

deadline.text: Apply on MahaDBT; no date on scheme page
